question: Does the human PI approve the proposed bounded Lean trial: install the official elan toolchain manager into ~/.elan; pin Lean 4 and mathlib to matching v4.33.0 releases; accept their Apache-2.0 licenses for this project use; create formal/lean/; encode and check only PRF-05.01; make no CI, cloud-execution, or Python-dependency changes; and retain the existing prohibition on generated build output?

options.summary: Approve the proposed bounded Lean trial.
options.consequence: Authorize the official elan installation, matching Lean 4/mathlib v4.33.0 toolchain, project-local formal/lean source and native manifests, and implementation/checking of PRF-05.01 only. No other theorem, backend, CI integration, cloud execution, Python dependency, or generated output is authorized.
Keep executable Lean implementation inactive; retain only the frozen prover-neutral contracts and conceptual architecture.

options.summary: Require a different Lean version, installation method, dependency boundary, or trial scope.
options.consequence: Keep implementation blocked until the human specifies and accepts the replacement dependency and execution decision.

recommendation: Option A: use the official elan installer, pin matching Lean 4 and mathlib v4.33.0 releases, implement only PRF-05.01, and keep CI, cloud execution, Python dependencies, all other PRF-05 contracts, Isabelle, and Rocq outside this trial.
blocked_scope: Lean installation; creation of formal/lean/ executable infrastructure; addition of Lean or mathlib dependencies; execution of Lean or Lake; implementation or checking of any PRF-05 theorem.
safe_scope: Read-only inspection of official Lean, mathlib, installation, release, and license information; inspection of the frozen theorem catalog and repository architecture.
normalized_decision: Option A accepted: authorize the bounded local Lean trial using the official elan installer, matching Lean 4 and mathlib v4.33.0 releases under their Apache-2.0 licenses, project-local formal/lean source and native manifests, and implementation and checking of PRF-05.01 only.
authorized_scope: Install elan into ~/.elan; obtain and execute the pinned Lean 4 v4.33.0 toolchain and matching mathlib v4.33.0 dependency; create formal/lean/ with native Lean/Lake manifests and source needed for PRF-05.01; download official dependency artifacts and mathlib caches; encode, build, and check PRF-05.01 locally. Do not implement PRF-05.02 through PRF-05.08, create Isabelle or Rocq sources, configure CI or cloud execution, change Python dependencies or lockfiles, run scientific calculations, commit generated build/cache output, or broaden dependency and licensing scope.
